name: SEMUST
author: semust

sections.description:
SEMUST SEO Plugin bridges your WordPress site with the SEMUST SEO platform, enabling seamless integration for all SEMUST features that interact with your content.

What is SEMUST?

SEMUST is a comprehensive SEO platform that helps you optimize your website with AI-powered tools including:

  • Internal Link Suggestions – Automatically discover and apply internal linking opportunities
  • Content Optimization – AI-assisted content creation and optimization
  • SEO Audits – Comprehensive site analysis and recommendations
  • Keyword Research – Find the best keywords for your content
  • And much more…

Visit semust.com to learn about all available features.

Plugin Features:

  • Simple API key authentication
  • Secure communication with timing-safe key validation
  • Automatic content updates when you approve changes in SEMUST
  • Compatible with popular caching plugins
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance
sections.installation:
1. Upload the semust folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > SEMUST and enter your API key
  4. Start using SEMUST features with your WordPress site
sections.faq:
Where do I find my API key?

Your API key is located in your SEMUST account settings:

  1. Log in to your SEMUST account at app.semust.com
  2. Click on your profile icon in the top right corner
  3. Navigate to Settings > Profile
  4. Your API key will be displayed in the API Key section

For security, the API key is partially hidden by default. Click the eye icon to reveal the full key, then use the copy button to copy it to your clipboard.

Can I reset my API key?

Yes! If you believe your API key has been compromised or you simply want to generate a new one:

  1. Go to your SEMUST account Settings > Profile
  2. Click the Reset button next to your API key
  3. Confirm the reset in the dialog that appears
  4. Copy your new API key and update it in your WordPress plugin settings

Important: After resetting your API key, you must update the key in all WordPress sites using the SEMUST SEO Plugin. The old key will stop working immediately.

Is my content safe?

Yes! SEMUST only modifies your content when you explicitly approve changes in the SEMUST dashboard. No modifications are made without your consent.

What features require this plugin?

This plugin is required for any SEMUST feature that needs to read or modify your WordPress content, such as:

  • Applying internal link suggestions
  • Content synchronization
  • Future integrations and features

For more details about SEMUST capabilities, visit semust.com.

How do I get support?

For support and questions, please visit semust.com or contact us through the SEMUST dashboard.
